Пульт, графики температур и отправка G-c: Printer controls, temperature charts and G-code transfer use clients based on the Moonraker, Klipper and OctoPrint API documentation. The embedded browser opens the configured printer UI. Native model cards use Thingiverse, Printables, Cults3D and MakerWorld JSON APIs and show author, source, license and available price. Quick Print uses your presets and local slicing. The layout was inspired by Bambu Handy's Prepare to Print screen; this Android implementation was written for this adaptation. Cults does not provide model files through its API.
STL, ZIP и геометрия 3MF; один объект и: STL, ZIP and 3MF geometry; one object and material, 638 settings, custom presets, model cards, search, tags, cache, toolpath preview with Dev menu, and multiple printers. Painting and multimaterial slicing are not supported. “90% compatibility” has not been measured.
